levels.description: Randomly generates one enemy from the following: <@ba.enemy>Roar Knightclub Trainee</>, <@ba.enemy>Nameless Independent Knight</>, <@ba.enemy>Independent Knight Shielder</>, <@ba.enemy>Bloodboil Knightclub Trainee</> (grants <@ba.drop>Elite Advancement Tokens</> based on the enemy defeated); once this enemy is defeated, the Operator deployed on this [Impact Fence] gains 3% ATK
